verdict.rationale: Insomnia ships an official CLI, Inso CLI, documented on Kong's developer site. It automates API test runs, lints OpenAPI specs (`inso lint spec`), and is built for non-interactive CI use: it disables prompts and returns pass/fail exit codes, which suits scripted and agent-driven workflows. Missing for 10: evidence of agent-oriented affordances such as structured/JSON output, documented coverage beyond testing and linting, and independent or hands-on corroboration of CLI use.
